Lifesign Scan is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of
. It is unlocked by getting itself to level 7. It is also a stage item on
at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.
